queries: WITH product_counts AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), shares AS (SELECT line_count, 1.0 * line_count / SUM(line_count) OVER () AS share FROM product_counts), compared AS (SELECT line_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(line_count) AS combined_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > overall_average_share

WITH product_counts AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), product_shares AS (SELECT product_id, item_count, 1.0 * item_count / SUM(item_count) OVER () AS share FROM product_counts), overall AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM product_shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ps.item_count), 0) AS combined_count, AVG(ps.share) AS average_share, AVG(ps.share - o.average_share) AS average_excess FROM product_shares ps CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ps.share > o.average_share;
